list.name: client
list.label: Client
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT name AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM t_org_clients ORDER BY __text

list.name: area
list.label: Area
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT area AS __text, area AS __value FROM t_sys_analytics_taxonomy ORDER BY __text

list.name: feature
list.label: Feature
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT feature AS __text, feature AS __value FROM t_sys_analytics_taxonomy WHERE ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') ORDER BY __text

list.name: sub_feature
list.label: Sub-feature
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT sub_feature AS __text, sub_feature AS __value FROM t_sys_analytics_taxonomy WHERE sub_feature IS NOT NULL AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') ORDER BY __text

panels.title: Most visited areas
panels.description: Top-level areas ranked by page-visit count. One visit = one route-level entry into the area; internal tab switches within a page do NOT inflate this count (see the Nested tabs panel for those).

targets.rawSql: SELECT area, COUNT(*)::int AS visits FROM t_analytics_events WHERE event_time > now() - '${range}'::interval AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR client_id::text = '${client}') AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') AND sub_feature IS NULL GROUP BY area ORDER BY visits DESC

panels.title: Most visited features
panels.description: Pages / features people actually open, counted as page visits only. Tab switches inside a page do NOT inflate this count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT area || ' → ' || feature AS page, COUNT(*)::int AS visits FROM t_analytics_events WHERE event_time > now() - '${range}'::interval AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR client_id::text = '${client}') AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') AND sub_feature IS NULL GROUP BY area, feature ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Most visited nested tabs (sub-features)
panels.description: Deepest level — which tabs inside a feature people actually open. Rows only appear when a sub_feature is recorded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT area || ' → ' || feature || ' → ' || sub_feature AS tab, COUNT(*)::int AS visits FROM t_analytics_events WHERE event_time > now() - '${range}'::interval AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR client_id::text = '${client}') AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') AND ('${sub_feature}' = 'All' OR sub_feature = '${sub_feature}') AND sub_feature IS NOT NULL GROUP BY area, feature, sub_feature ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Usage by role
panels.description: Which roles produce the traffic. Only roles listed in the client's analytics.tracked_roles are recorded — everyone else is invisible to this dashboard by design.

targets.rawSql: SELECT role, COUNT(*)::int AS visits FROM t_analytics_events WHERE event_time > now() - '${range}'::interval AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR client_id::text = '${client}') AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') AND ('${sub_feature}' = 'All' OR sub_feature = '${sub_feature}') GROUP BY role ORDER BY visits DESC

panels.title: Usage by client
panels.description: One row per client. `active_users` counts distinct user_id in the window — a truer signal of adoption than raw event count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.name AS client, COUNT(*)::int AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.user_id)::int AS active_users FROM t_analytics_events ae JOIN t_org_clients c ON c.id = ae.client_id WHERE ae.event_time > now() - '${range}'::interval AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR ae.area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR ae.feature = '${feature}') AND ('${sub_feature}' = 'All' OR ae.sub_feature = '${sub_feature}') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY events DESC

panels.title: Zero / low-usage features (last window)
panels.description: Features in the taxonomy that recorded ZERO events in the window. Sourced from t_sys_analytics_taxonomy (LEFT JOIN vs events) so every declared feature is accountable — not just the ones that happened to fire.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.area, t.feature FROM (SELECT DISTINCT area, feature FROM t_sys_analytics_taxonomy WHERE sub_feature IS NULL) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT area, feature FROM t_analytics_events WHERE event_time > now() - '${range}'::interval AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR client_id::text = '${client}')) e ON e.area = t.area AND e.feature = t.feature WHERE e.feature IS NULL ORDER BY t.area, t.feature
